_comment: Trips shown on the 'pick a trip' map of every Swiss page. Each trip lives on one page (slug); s/e/p are that page's start, end and fork picks. `geo` (km, climb, effort, line in lat/lon) is written by tools/trips_geo.py from the published pages - never by hand.

trips.name: East–West crossing
trips.note: The whole country, east to west

trips.name: North–South crossing
trips.note: National Route 3 over the Gotthard
trips.why: the classic Gotthard crossing, the most-ridden crossing of the country

trips.name: Rhône
trips.note: National Route 1 · EuroVelo 17 · mostly descending
trips.why: one of Switzerland's most popular long-distance routes: glacier source, the Valais, the Lavaux vineyards

trips.name: Rhine
trips.note: National Route 2 · start of EuroVelo 15 · Oberalp, Lake Constance, Rhine Falls
trips.why: the Rhine from its source over the Oberalp to Basel: Lake Constance, the Rhine Falls at Schaffhausen, flat and beginner-friendly after Chur

trips.name: Alpine Panorama
trips.note: National Route 4 · Appenzell, Klausen, Lake Lucerne boats, Glaubenbielen, Col des Mosses
trips.why: the toughest and most scenic national route: 480 km along the northern edge of the Alps, one pass after another

trips.name: Mittelland
trips.note: National Route 5 · Lake Constance to Lake Geneva · Baden, Aarau, Solothurn, the south shore of Lake Neuchâtel
trips.why: the flattest way across the country: rivers, old towns and the Jura foot, good for families and e-bikes

trips.name: Graubünden
trips.note: National Route 6 through the Engadin · signed Chur → Müstair, shown the other way round
trips.why: glorious Alpine stretches through the Engadin

trips.name: Jura
trips.note: National Route 7 · along the Jura crest · Delémont, La Chaux-de-Fonds, Sainte-Croix, Vallée de Joux
trips.why: quiet fir plateaux and watch valleys the whole length of the Jura, rated difficult for its constant climbing

trips.name: Aare
trips.note: National Route 8 · Grimsel, Interlaken, Bern, Solothurn, down the Aare to the Rhine
trips.why: follows one river from the Grimsel glacier to the Rhine: Lake Brienz and Thun, Bern, Solothurn, mostly downhill

trips.name: Lakes
trips.note: National Route 9 · signed Montreux → Rorschach, shown the other way round · our line goes via Schwyz
trips.why: the most accessible long-distance route for recreational cyclists: ten lakes, Luzern, Lavaux

trips.name: Heart Route
trips.note: Herzroute 99 · Appenzell, Einsiedeln, Emmental, Gruyère country · the e-bike classic, always the quiet hilly way
trips.why: the most-loved e-bike route in the country: 13 stages of quiet hills between Lake Constance and Lake Geneva, every one a detour from the valley

trips.name: Furka pass
trips.note: 2,429 m · down to the Rhône glacier

trips.name: Grimsel pass
trips.note: 2,164 m · past the Grimsel lakes

trips.name: Oberalp pass
trips.note: 2,044 m · the Rhine's source

trips.name: Gotthard pass
trips.note: 2,106 m · the old Tremola cobbles on the south side

trips.name: San Bernardino
trips.note: 2,066 m · the quiet way into Ticino

trips.name: Lötschberg car train
trips.note: climb to Goppenstein, train through the mountain, down the Kander valley

trips.name: Lake Lucerne boat and Gotthard road
trips.note: boat Brunnen → Flüelen, then the Reuss valley up to Andermatt

trips.name: Three passes loop
trips.note: Susten, Grimsel and Furka in one circuit
trips.why: komoot's top-rated road ride in Switzerland, 'The High Triple'

trips.name: Grand Alpine crossing
trips.note: Oberalp, Furka and the whole Rhône valley

trips.name: Pre-Alps and lakes
trips.note: Brünig, Interlaken, Gstaad, Château-d'Œx

trips.name: Lake Constance circuit
trips.note: Bodensee-Radweg · Bregenz, Lindau, Friedrichshafen, Überlingen, the Untersee · three countries, flat
trips.why: Europe's best-known lake circuit: flat, signed all the way round, a ferry or boat whenever you want a short cut

trips.name: Tour du Lac Léman
trips.note: Lavaux, Montreux, then the French shore: Évian, Thonon, Yvoire · flat
trips.why: the whole of Lake Geneva in two or three days: Lavaux vineyards one side, the Alps mirrored from the French shore on the other

trips.name: Three Lakes loop
trips.note: Lake Biel, Lake Neuchâtel and Lake Murten in one flat circuit
trips.why: the classic easy weekend loop of the Seeland: vineyards on Lake Biel, the old town of Murten, flat all the way

trips.name: Gotthard crossing
trips.note: the heart of Route 3: Lake Lucerne, the Reuss valley, the pass

trips.name: Ticino lakes
trips.note: Lugano and Lake Como's Swiss shore

trips.name: Furka–Nufenen–Gotthard loop
trips.note: Furka, Nufenen and the Gotthard in one circuit
trips.why: komoot's other three-pass loop from Andermatt
